scope: FD-005 user-accepted library and matrix improvements; final version-only release build, package validation and Windows smoke checks.

accepted_trial.release_html_delta: Only displayed footer version 1.5.1 to 1.6.0; byte-for-byte equality after this replacement.
accepted_trial.catalog: 12 domains with 30 entries each; all 360 checked for distinct IDs, parser, markup and copy payloads. Separate domain reviews and representative numerical checks; not a formal mathematical proof.
accepted_trial.library_web: Manual add; edit built-in name/source/note; domain rename/add/reorder; search/pagination; save/reload; real export/import preserving raw fields and workspace.
accepted_trial.library_native: 400/560 px manual entry, names and focus; import, save, close/reopen same EXE, export with exact saved-document match; 400 px native confirmation cancel/accept, deletion undo and cancel all modifications.
accepted_trial.failure_paths: Controller tests for storage rejection/retry and recovery authorization; real Windows I/O for locked target, atomic replacement, strict UTF-8, size bounds, valid backup preservation and damaged original archiving.
accepted_trial.matrix: 1x1/2x3/10x10; nested fractions and multiple matrices; selection-invalidated confirmation; delete/cancel/undo/redo/full restore. Column-placeholder regression failed with four instead of six, then passed for left/right columns, typing, Tab and exact-source undo/redo.
accepted_trial.clipboard: Real paste into independent WinForms textbox. Restored LaTeX exact; formula-and-note normalized accessibility text exact and line breaks visually checked.
accepted_trial.native_regression: 560 px stable first input; 400 px direct input after clear and four keyboard pages at 517 px window height; Ctrl+S/Ctrl+O dialogs cancel without changing content. Hotkey conflict warning verified.

release_build.native: Original toolbar appearance; new 2x3 matrix has six visible input placeholders on Windows 560 px. Catalog and installed shortcut smoke checks recorded separately from trial evidence.

limits: Windows 10, system DPI changes, mixed-DPI moves and other browsers not retested.
Full keyboard long-press, conflict-free global hotkey and worksheet reopen use prior FD-004/FD-003 evidence; not counted as this task native reruns.
Browser storage failures and damaged recovery are controller/file tests, not exhaustive native UI tests.
Formula review and rendering do not establish universal mathematical correctness.
